event_name: Date 19 October 2018 Time 10:38 2018 UNITED STATES GRAND PRIX 18 - 21 October 2018 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Technical Delegate (document 7), have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: A 7th Internal Combustion Engine (ICE), 7th Turbo Charger (TC), 7th Motor Generator Unit Heat (MGU-H) and 6th Motor Generator Unit - Kinetic (MGU-K) have been used.
offence: Breach of Article 23.3 (a) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: Required to start the race from the back of the starting grid.
reason: The penalty is imposed in accordance with Article 23.3 b).
